prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail rose pink hair — painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework — an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck. Pose: turned in full profile, back straight, chin raised — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: the most absurdly extreme heels imaginable — gold extreme platform buckled boots, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, painted in the same colours as her body art.
#1: Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face and ears are NOT painted — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque matte classic red lips with a precise edge, a sharp black winged liner, defined lashes, a clean complexion.

#2: a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, mid 50s, a legendary Eastern beauty said to topple nations, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, shaggy layered natural black hair — full body glossy black urushi lacquer fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid lacquered curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lacquer sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING mirror-black urushi lacquer across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold maki-e waves, pines and moons between the sections, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, mirror-gloss lacquered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: arms crossed under her bust, intense gaze straight into the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same lacquer, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same lacquer with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face and ears are NOT lacquer — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Environment: a long white fashion-show runway with a glossy white floor, standard-height steps at the end and softly lit empty rows of seats, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as any of them.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, every element standing in true relief, nothing flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
